whatWeDo.title: AnyRide ezali nini?
whatWeDo.description: AnyRide ezali kaka application ya kotambola te — ezali mokano oyo etongami likoló ya bonsomi, bondimi, mpe pete ya mokolo na mokolo. Tobandaki AnyRide na mokano moko ya pete: kosala kotambola na engumba ezala pete, ya libateli, mpe ya litomba mpo na bato nyonso — ezala ozali kokende mbangu to kozwa mbongo na nsima ya volant. Tososoli makambo elimboli kosala, kotambola, mpe kosala makambo — yango wana AnyRide esalamaki mpo na kosalela bato ya solo na bamposa ya solo. Plateforme na biso ekangisaka bato oyo bazali kotambola mpe batambwisi na basegɔnde, kosalisa bango mibale kobomba ntango, kozwa mbongo mingi, mpe kotambola na motema kitoko na mokolo na bango mobimba.

vision.title: Emoniseli na biso
vision.subtitle: Emoniseli ezali kokende na mokili mobimba
vision.description: Kotonga réseau ya kotambola ya mboka oyo bandimi mingi koleka na Afrique — oyo ezali kotya bato, kaka technologie te, na katikati. Tozali kosala kaka mitambola te; tozali kotonga maponami kati na bato, mabaku, mpe babalabala ya libateli.

mission.title: Mokano na biso
mission.subtitle: Tozali awa kaka mpo na yo
mission.description: Kobongisa transport ya mboka na kosala transport nyonso ezala pete, ya ntalo moke, mpe ya nguya — mpo na bato oyo bazali kotambola mpe batambwisi. Tondimi ete kotambola esengeli kozala na mitungisi te, ya libateli te, to ya ntalo makasi te. Moto nyonso asengeli kozala na transport ya sembo, ya polele, mpe ya pete ya kondima.

riders.title: Bato oyo bazali kotambola
riders.description: Engumba na yo ezali kaka na ba-clics moke. AnyRide epesaka yo bokonzi likoló na ndenge otambolaka — kobanda na makambo ya mbangu tii na mitambola ya molai. Mona mbongo na yo liboso, landela motambwisi na yo na ntango ya solo, mpe sepela na kimia ya motema koyeba ozali na mabɔkɔ ya libateli. Likambo ya kokamwa te. Mitungisi te.

drivers.title: Batambwisi
drivers.description: Tomonaka batambwisi lokola bapartenaire, kaka basaleli te. Na AnyRide, oponi ntango ya kotambwisa, ndenge ya kozwa mbongo, mpe motuka nini osaleli. Bongola mituka pete, kobimisa mbongo nokinoki, mpe kokola mbongo na yo na mpasi ya mingi te. Système na biso etongami mpo na kosunga yo — litamboli nyonso, transport nyonso.

ourPromise.title: Kamata maloba na biso
ourPromise.description: Tozali kosala likambo ya kokesana — mayele ya kotambola oyo emonanaka lokola ya mboka, ya sembo, mpe ya bato. Kobanda na batambwisi na biso oyo bazali kobatela engumba etambolaka, tii na bato oyo bazali kotambola oyo bandimi biso mokolo na mokolo, AnyRide etelemaka mpo na libateli, sembo, mpe nguya. Mpo kotambola ezali bonsomi — mpe moto nyonso asengeli kozala na nzela ya kokende. Yango nde AnyRide. Etongami mpo na bato. Esalamaki mpo na kotambola.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Politique ya Vie Privée
PrivacyPolicy.lastUpdated: Mise à jour ya suka: Janvier 2025

section1.title: Introduction
section1.content: AnyRide ezali na engagement ya kobatela vie privée na yo. Politique ya Vie Privée oyo ezali kolimbola ndenge tozali kokongola, kosalela, kokabola, mpe kobatela makambo na yo ntango ozali kosalela plateforme na biso.

section2.title: Makambo Tokongolaka
section2.content: Tokongolaka makambo opesi polele, lokola nkombo na yo, adresse email, numéro ya téléphone, ba-données ya esika, mpe makambo ya kofuta. Tokongolaka pe makambo mosusu na ndenge automatique na ntina ya appareil na yo mpe ndenge osaleli yango.

section3.title: Ndenge Tosaleli Makambo na yo
section3.content: Tosaleli makambo na yo mpo na kopesa, kobatela, mpe kobongisa misala na biso, kosala ba-transactions, kotindela yo ba-mises à jour, mpe kotosa mibeko.

section4.title: Kokabola Makambo
section4.content: Totɛki te makambo na yo ya personnel. Tokoki kokabola makambo na bapesi misala, bapartenaire, mpe ntango mibeko esengi.

section5.title: Sécurité ya Ba-données
section5.content: Tosaleli ba-mesures techniques mpe organisationnelles ya malamu mpo na kobatela makambo na yo ya personnel liboso ya ba-accès oyo endimami te, kobongola, komonisa, to kobebisa.

section6.title: Makoki na yo
section6.content: Ozali na makoki ya kokɔta, kobongisa, to kolongola makambo na yo ya personnel. Okoki pe kotika ba-communications mosusu. Bengelá biso mpo na kosalela makoki oyo.

TermsAndConditions.title: Mibeko mpe Mipango
TermsAndConditions.lastUpdated: Mise à jour ya suka: Janvier 2025

section1.title: Kondima Mibeko
section1.content: Na kokɔta mpe kosalela AnyRide, ondimi mpe ondimi kozala na kanga na mibeko mpe ba-provisions ya boyokani oyo.

section2.title: Licence ya Kosalela
section2.content: Ndingisa epesami ya ko-télécharger kopi moko ya matériels (makambo to logiciel) na AnyRide mpo na botali ya ntango moke ya personnel, oyo ezali ya commerce te. Oyo ezali ndingisa, kaka kopesa titre te.

section3.title: Disclaimer
section3.content: Matériels na AnyRide epesami na base 'tel quel'. AnyRide ezali na ba-garanties te, oyo elimbolami to te, mpe awa ezali kotikala mpe koboya ba-garanties nyonso mosusu incluant, sans limitation, ba-garanties implicites to ba-conditions ya marchandabilité, adéquation à un objectif particulier, to non-violation ya propriété intellectuelle to violation mosusu ya makoki.

section4.title: Mipekiseli
section4.content: Na likambo nyonso AnyRide to bapesi na yango bakoki kozala na responsabilité mpo na ba-dommages nyonso (incluant, sans limitation, ba-dommages mpo na kobungisa ba-données to litomba, to mpo na kotelema ya commerce) oyo ebimi na kosalela to likoki te ya kosalela matériels na AnyRide.

section5.title: Bosikisiki ya Matériels
section5.content: Matériels oyo emonanaka na AnyRide ekoki kozala na ba-erreurs techniques, typographiques, to photographiques. AnyRide ezali kopesa garantie te ete matériels nyonso na AnyRide ezali ya sikisiki, complète, to ya lelo.

section6.title: Ba-Liens
section6.content: AnyRide etalisi te ba-sites nyonso oyo ekangami na site internet na yango mpe ezali na responsabilité te mpo na contenus ya site nyonso oyo ekangami boye. Inclusion ya lien nyonso ezali kolimbola endorsement na AnyRide ya site yango te. Kosalela site internet nyonso oyo ekangami boye ezali na risque ya mosaleli.

section7.title: Ba-Modifications
section7.content: AnyRide ekoki kobongisa mibeko oyo ya service mpo na site internet na yango ntango nyonso na avertissement te. Na kosalela site internet oyo, ozali kondima kozala na kanga na version ya lelo ya mibeko oyo ya service.

WhoCanApply.description: AnyRide ezali koluka bato oyo bazali na mayele, bososoli, mpe boyebi ya makambo ya solosolo — mingi mpenza na misala oyo etali transport mpe opérations.
